title: An erase this phone cannot read at all, or a relaunch on an erased record that will not draw, keeps the reminders opt-in and first-seen files
evidence: Privacy-adjacent; soon. From S63 (shapes b and c, left open by S70 + S63). An erase this phone cannot read at all (the cloud file refused, ios/engine/cloud.ts ~:360-363) or a relaunch on an erased record that will not draw leaves the reminders opt-in and first-seen files on the phone; Swift never learns the erase identity. Needs an engine door that reads a refused record's raw meta.eraseEpoch (as record-session-erase.ts ~:27 reads schemaVersion); engine plus health-core, so an engine release (S63 shapes b and c). Also S63 shape (a) through a new session's open: on a relaunch or connect, CloudSync's handOver (RecordStore+Source.swift ~:173) draws a view while source is .phone, so draw(_ view:)'s hold (RecordStore.swift ~:219, same-session only) does not apply; an erased view the engine cannot draw returns .failed and the phone's pre-erase copy stays shown, reminders scheduling from it. A Swift-only fix may exist (hold a handOver whose erase identity's epoch differs from the drawn eraseEpoch); owner's call, found by the adversary on the S70 + S63 PR (F1). US-25 AC16j, AC12b.
